scores.tell: Clock rim is smooth satin plastic with soft highlights, a bit uniform; otherwise close to real cards.
Dome and module are smooth, evenly glossy plastic. Lunar sand is soft and plain. Fine detail is minimal.
Painterly sand and bottle glass have mixed matte and gloss. The cork has fine texture. Close to real cards.
Cactus is uniformly glossy clay or rubber with no surface variation. The spines are chunky white pegs.
Pump has mixed gloss and matte, with cracked stone and scuffed barrel. A little too much glossy lacquer on the red body.
Ice cream, cone and neon outline are all the same glossy, glowing plastic. The wafer grid is shallow and uniform.
Stone table has fine speckle and soft matte. Grass is painterly. The checkerboard is slightly flat.
Rope twist has fine ridges and a soft satin finish, like the real towel's fine texture. The finish is slightly uniform.
Dark boiler has a hard, uniform glossy shine and metal reads as plastic. Few fine details like grain or wear.
Rover body is smooth glossy plastic with the same shine on tyres and metal. The ground is a noisy grey, and the tyres have little rubber texture.
